triangle_shape.detail: filled 2-simplex has 3 vertices, 3 edges, 1 triangle after downward closure

boundary_of_boundary_zero.detail: d^2 = 0 must hold exactly over Z

baseline_boundary_matches.detail: each B1 column has exactly one +1 and one -1 entry (signed incidence)

cellcomplex_square.detail: square 2-cell must induce 4 nodes, 4 boundary edges, 1 cell

edges_only_no_2simplex.detail: two disjoint edges must not induce a triangle

duplicate_vertex_simplex_normalized.detail: simplex with repeated vertex must be rejected or normalized (no degenerate 2-simplex)

disconnected_two_zero_eigs.detail: #connected components = multiplicity of 0 in L0 spectrum

empty_complex.detail: empty complex must have no cells of any rank

duplicate_insertion_idempotent.detail: re-adding an existing simplex must not change shape

permutation_invariant_simplex.detail: simplices are unordered sets; vertex-order permutation must not add a new simplex

operation_sequence: construct a filled 2-simplex as a SimplicialComplex
read simplex counts by rank from downward closure
compute the rank-1 incidence matrix from edges to vertices
compute the rank-2 incidence matrix from the triangle to edges
verify boundary-of-boundary zero by multiplying B1 and B2
compute the rank-0 Hodge Laplacian spectrum
read edge faces from the rank-1 skeleton
construct a square CellComplex 2-cell and verify induced node, edge, and cell counts
run adjacent negative and boundary fixtures for edge-only, duplicate-vertex, disconnected, empty, singleton, duplicate-insertion, and permutation-invariant complexes

boundary_fixtures: permuted vertex ordering of the same simplex

observable.primary: incidence-matrix rank, sign structure, boundary composition, and Hodge-Laplacian spectrum
secondary: shape invariance under duplicate and permuted simplex insertion

pass: B1 has rank 2 and each edge column has balanced signs
rank-1 skeleton contains exactly the three triangle edges
manual signed-incidence baseline has one positive and one negative entry per edge column
square CellComplex induces four nodes, four boundary edges, and one rank-2 cell
duplicate-vertex simplex is rejected or normalized without a degenerate 2-simplex
disconnected triangle plus isolated vertex has two zero L0 eigenvalues
empty, singleton, duplicate-insertion, and permutation boundary checks pass
fail: any incidence, Hodge spectrum, cell count, negative, or boundary check misses its expected finite-complex invariant

graveyards.name: edges_only_no_2simplex
graveyards.change: insert only two edges without the filling 2-simplex
graveyards.expected_death: triangle rank-2 cell does not appear

graveyards.name: duplicate_vertex_simplex
graveyards.change: attempt simplex insertion with repeated vertex [0, 0, 1]
graveyards.expected_death: degenerate 2-simplex is rejected or normalized away

graveyards.name: disconnected_triangle_plus_vertex
graveyards.change: add an isolated vertex to the filled triangle
graveyards.expected_death: L0 zero-eigenvalue multiplicity changes from one to two

baselines.name: manual_signed_boundary_matrix
baselines.role: numpy baseline checking that each B1 edge column has one +1 and one -1 entry

baselines.name: triangle_graph_laplacian_spectrum
baselines.role: hand-computed boundary baseline for L0 eigenvalues [0, 3, 3]

alternative_formulations: NetworkX graph Laplacian for the triangle 1-skeleton
GUDHI SimplexTree with the same filled triangle filtration
manual chain-complex boundary matrices for C2 -> C1 -> C0
surviving_alternatives: This receipt covers only bounded TopoNetX complex/incidence capability; it does not promote a cell-complex lego, topology coupling, bridge, axis, GStack, or nonclassical admission.
demotion_condition: Demote this TopoNetX capability receipt if filled-triangle shape, boundary rank/sign checks, boundary-of-boundary zero, Hodge spectrum, cell-complex square incidence, or degenerate simplex controls fail on rerun.
claim_ceiling: finite sim_toponetx_capability lego receipt only; no bridge, GStack, axis, QIT, or nonclassical admission
next_lego_target: Use as bounded TopoNetX simplicial/cell-complex capability evidence before exact topology lego-fit or coupling packets.
promotion_condition: Requires separate coupling/coexistence receipts and explicit stage-gate approval.
blocked_until: explicit coupling-stage admission and companion receipts
